name: meeting-copilot
description: Real-time AI meeting copilot: Chrome extension (MV3) + local Node server

scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w extension
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w extension
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build && npm run validate:manifest && npm run smoke -w server
